allowed_claim_language: The report computes exact finite rational series and product endpoints.
The report records whether each endpoint and intended construction edge exists in the selected strict corpus.
A direct quotient landing is graph evidence for that rational value, not evidence for the series recurrence.
Missing recurrence edges may expose the strict positive-spine operand boundary.
disallowed_claim_language: Do not claim that endpoint presence means MoO constructed a geometric or zeta series.
Do not claim that finite agreement constructs zeta(2), pi, or a completed infinite object.
Do not treat scaled integer-division witnesses as independent series routes.
Do not use this probe to authorize speculative rational operands.
interpretation_limits: Every reported sum and product is finite and exactly rational.
The zeta(2) and infinite geometric limits are external projection labels.
Family meaning requires recorded recurrence/product edges, not value collision alone.
Controls and held-out corpus comparisons are still required before promotion beyond observation.

alignment.operand_rule: positive-spine strict corpus: only confirmed positive-spine iterations may be operands

final_finite_endpoint_comparison.interpretation: exact finite truncation comparison only; different cutoffs do not constitute a convergence result

cross_family.identity_lens: zeta(2) = product_p (1-p^-2)^-1, with each factor an infinite geometric series in p^-2

shared_endpoint_collisions.interpretation: shared rational endpoint only; construction alignment requires the family-specific recurrence edges
shared rational endpoint only; construction alignment requires the family-specific recurrence edges

geometric.indexing: term_count K includes exponents 0 through K-1
